scene_description: Two pieces of white paper on a wooden table, each decorated with animal pictures made from autumn leaves. The left paper shows a butterfly and a hedgehog made from colorful fall leaves and red berries. The right paper shows a butterfly, an owl, and a bird, also made from leaves and natural materials.

questions.question: What are the animals made from?
questions.evidence_hint: Look closely at what the animals on the white papers are made of.

questions.question: What animal is at the top of the left paper?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top part of the paper on the left side.

questions.question: What animal is on the right paper with big round eyes?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the right paper and find the animal with two big round eyes.

questions.question: Who is holding the scissors?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bottom of the picture near the table.

questions.question: Where are the leaf pictures?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the flat surface under the white papers.
